content: CRM bulk import UX: column mapping should auto-suggest based on header name match but let user override/drag-drop map each column; provide a downloadable template so headers match expected fields. Duplicate detection should flag existing-looking records before import and let user choose create-vs-update rather than silently overwrite or silently duplicate. Recommend starting with a small test batch (10-20 rows) before full import, and tagging/tracking import source metadata to distinguish new vs migrated data.
